name: LavaUSD
oneLiner: LavaUSD is Lava's Solana dollar stablecoin issued through Bridge, backed by issuer-reported cash and Treasury reserves, awaiting an admitted price lane.
collateral: Bridge reports U.S. dollar cash and a Treasury category that includes money-market funds with Treasury-bill ladders of less than three-month duration. Named cash banks, fund allocations, and an independent LavaUSD reserve attestation were not retrieved.
pegMechanism: Bridge issues LavaUSD on Solana as a Token-2022 stablecoin used to fund Lava accounts, payments, and stablecoin conversions. Default token accounts are initialized with no transfer hook; token-specific direct redemption terms outside the Lava app remain unverified.

proofOfReserves.provider: Bridge issuer dashboard and reserve JSON; no independently reconciled LavaUSD reserve report retrieved

launchPhaseDetail: LavaUSD is issued on Solana as an open-loop Token-2022 mint with initialized default accounts and no transfer hook. The recorded launch date reflects the first observed mint by its current mint authority; Bridge publishes live supply and reserve categories, but no admitted price lane exists.

milestones.title: LavaUSD issuance is recorded on Solana
milestones.description: A Token-2022 mintToChecked instruction mints 1 LavaUSD at the Bridge-linked Solana mint alongside Bridge reserve-ledger issuance.

listingStatusReview.reason: No admitted price lane: DefiLlama price is null, the exact-mint quote is empty, CoinGecko returns 404 for lavausd, and DexScreener reports zero pools. DefiLlama supply and pinned Solana issuance are positive.
